episodes.synopsis: After an on-stream altercation, Masaki is unceremoniously booted from her group NewTube channel. Now her fate lies with a vampire who has just awoken from a deep slumber.
episodes.title: The Canceled Girl and the Sleepy Vampire

episodes.synopsis: Masaki begins uploading videos to a new channel with Live, Ichiko, and Fu. However, their meteoric rise to NewTube fame attracts some unwanted attention.
episodes.title: Starting a Channel! Good Morning From the Dead of Night!

episodes.synopsis: While struggling with content creator's block, Masaki comes across Tokage, a vampire strapped for cash and looking to strike it rich through NewTube videos.
episodes.title: A New Member Joins! DEAD or ALIVE

episodes.synopsis: Masaki discovers an old cassette tape that could lead to MayoPan's next big hit; however, it also holds memories for Fu that she'd rather not remember.
episodes.title: The Star of the Next Video Is Who?

episodes.synopsis: Annoyed at their lack of commitment, Masaki sends Live and the others to a desert island to spend a week thinking up and filming their own video.
episodes.title: Blood-or-Die! Desert Island Survival

episodes.synopsis: A rowdy night of drinking ends in massive property damage. Now it's up to Ichiko to talk Mother out of tearing down Banpai Manor, their beloved home.
episodes.title: Ichiko's Wish

episodes.synopsis: With only six months to hit a million subs, Masaki struggles to grow the channel. Meanwhile, Fu enters a parasocial relationship with an unlikely pair of content creators.
episodes.title: Your Faves Are Adorbs, Hit That Subscribe

episodes.synopsis: Mayonaka Punch are invited to take part in a NewTuber festival. Masaki soon finds out, however, that a live stage event won't go as planned so easily!
episodes.title: Starring in TSUMA FES Extreme!

episodes.synopsis: A family emergency brings Masaki back home to babysit her little sister, leaving the members of MayoPan to their own devices in shooting new videos.
episodes.title: Welcome. This Is Your New Family Home!

episodes.synopsis: A cryptic video hinting at a future new member goes up on the Mayonaka Punch channel, prompting Yuki to make a sudden visit to Banpai Manor.
episodes.title: Rampage x Fateful Showdown!

episodes.synopsis: The cat's out of the bag about Masaki's involvement with Mayonaka Punch, and the ensuing online reaction leaves Masaki at a loss for what to do.
episodes.title: Annoucement: Gone Missing

episodes.synopsis: With Live still nowhere to be found, the only hope for Mayonaka Punch is to bet it all on hitting a million subscribers in a single night!
episodes.title: The Last Live Stream
